Add your Showdown replays or a game log to find the leads, four-Pokémon brings, and matchups that win most. Rankings favor results that hold up across more games, not lucky streaks.

Export

Upload replays

Choose one or more Showdown replay files (.html) and each game is read automatically. You can also paste a CSV or JSON log. New games are added to what you already have, and replays already logged are skipped.

Column guide

One row per game. Only result, lead1, lead2, back1 and back2 are required.

match      Same ID for every game in one best-of-three set
game       1, 2 or 3
result     W or L
lead1/2    Your two leads
back1/2    Your two back Pokémon
opp_lead1/2  Their leads
opp_team   Their six, separated by / or ;
archetype  Your label for their team, like Rain or Trick Room
match,game,result,lead1,lead2,back1,back2,opp_lead1,opp_lead2,opp_team,archetype
